title: Ys III: Wanderers from Ys - Illburns Ruins
description:
One of the stage themes from Ys III. Based on the Mega Drive version instead of the SNES version by Tonkin House.

(Note: This area is known as Alcaino Ruins in the English localization of the Mega Drive and TurboGrafx-CD version.)
